name: SocketGateway wrapped-token swap route arbitrary call
summary: Socket route 406 (WrappedTokenSwapperImpl 0xcc5fda5e3ca925bd0bb428c8b2669496ee43067e) is delegatecalled by SocketGateway and, in performAction, forwards fully caller-controlled calldata to a caller-controlled address with `fromToken.call(swapExtraData)`. With amount = 0 the surrounding balance-delta and safeTransferFrom checks are satisfied trivially, so the attacker made the gateway execute `USDC.transferFrom(victim, attacker, allowance)` and equivalent calls on WETH, USDT, WBTC, DAI and MATIC, draining every unlimited approval users held on SocketGateway. The route had been registered three days earlier through NewRouteAdded(uint32,address); the gateway itself was never upgraded.
notes: NewRouteAdded(uint32 indexed routeId, address indexed route) log 345 of transaction 0x1df44e22, with topic1 = routeId 0x196 (406) and topic2 = route 0xcc5fda5e3ca925bd0bb428c8b2669496ee43067e. This is the 22nd and last of the 22 NewRouteAdded events the gateway emitted before the exploit; routes(406) reads 0x0 at block 18996161 and 0xcc5fda5e.. at block 19021453, routesCount is 407 so no later addRoute could overwrite id 406, and RouteDisabled never fired.

The campaign is exactly two transactions, both contract creations whose constructors run the drain: 0xc6c3331f at block 19021454 and 0x591d054a at block 19021465. Netting every ERC-20 Transfer in the two receipts gives the attacker EOA 0x50df5a2217588772471b84adbbe4194a2ed39066 a gain of 2,569,980.189709 USDC, 347,005.653023 USDT, 13,821.013832088432971148 DAI, 42.475261047009995242 WETH, 2.88962154 WBTC and 165,356.991611426813451965 MATIC, taken from roughly 200 distinct approval-granting victim addresses. All ten other routeId-406 calls to the gateway between installation and the exploit are small legitimate WETH wrap/unwrap swaps and are excluded. Stables are valued at par and the three volatile assets at DefiLlama observations within 95 seconds before the exploit. On 2024-01-22/23 the attacker returned 1,032 ETH to 0xc3a8af8c8bfc263030258afd80eb25afb6ff0820 and the full WETH, WBTC, DAI and MATIC balances plus 106.047775245495926983 ETH to 0xb4a3b6268c306833f75ebe43192c38905c992598, reported by Socket as about 2.3M USD recovered; recovery is not netted out of the exploit-time gross figure.
